notes: Each entry is one top-level URL prefix owned by another repository. The site deploy excludes these prefixes from upload and from rsync --delete. A publisher may deploy only its own path; this repository may deploy any registered path. When you add a prefix, stop shipping that directory from this repo or the live files will freeze on the last publisher upload.
